messages:
maria: Heads-up: planned publish for py/ts SDKs in quiet window at 02:00 UTC. CI just failed the publish job with a 401 on the npm token. Logs below. Holding until creds are resolved. @cheng @sam you around?

deploy-bot: publish job triggered by @maria at 02:01 UTC — npm publish -> ERROR 401 Unauthorized: registry.npmjs.org/: /-/npm/v1/security/reports

maria: here's the relevant snippet: `npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@redwood/sdk` (copied from CI job)

cheng: I can take the creds rotation. Looks like KMS rotated the `CI_NPM_TOKEN` yesterday and the pipeline didn't pick up the new secret. Investigating k8s secret sync.

sam: if we can't fix in 30m we should delay the push. We have release notes & deprecation RFC to ship too — don't want partial rollout.

jen: I'm on docs. I can finish the deprecation blurb and changelog entry if we delay. ETA ~40m.

cheng: found mismatch — deploy-k8s secret `sdk-npm-token` has old value. I'm going to update with service account key from vault. Running `kubectl -n ci set secret generic sdk-npm-token --from-literal=token=<REDACTED>` (will redact on commit)

maria: please confirm once CI re-runs green. Also need a rollback plan if publish partially succeeds across registries.

sam: rollback steps I prepared:
- npm: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk latest && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<prev> latest`
- pypi: cannot yank wheels reliably; plan is to republish a patch and update our release metadata to point to previous artifact, followed by a customer note
- create a post in #release-war-room and set a banner

alex: +1 to staging shadow publishes first. Can we gate on `--tag next` for npm and only flip `latest` after confirmation? deploy-bot can be given `--dist-tag next` flag.

maria: Good — decision: hold immediate flip. Re-run CI after secret update, publish under `next` tag only. If everything green, we flip `latest` at 03:30 UTC. If we see client breakage, yank the dist-tag and revert docs.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Publishing process flags: `--npm-tag next` `--pypi-test` `--dry-run` — ops will need to pass `--finalize` to flip.

cheng: CI re-run started at 02:18 UTC. npm step passed locally, getting through artifact upload.

deploy-bot: publish dry-run completed: npm package uploaded to registry under tag `next`, pypi test index OK.

jen: I pushed changelog + deprec blurb to PR and requested review from @maria. Link: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/456

maria: reviewing now. If all looks good, sam please be ready to flip at 03:30. Also, add a one-line customer-facing note to release notes: "We rotated publishing credentials; no API user change required."

sam: ready. I'll prepare rollback message template:
"Alert: SDK 2.1.0 publish retracted — use `npm install @redwood/sdk@2.0.7`. See incident thread: <link>"

cheng: secret rotation confirmed and documented in infra playbook.

maria: final call at 03:20 UTC. If no blockers -> finalize at 03:30. If blockers, we abort and republish after investigation.

alex: :thumbsup:

(ended thread - followups will be in #release-war-room if we need to yank or post customer comms)
